correctness.rationale: Gaussian restriction integrals reduce the functional to Grassmannian averages of determinants. The first two derivatives of the log determinant were reconstructed directly. Orthogonal invariance and the identities tr(P)=tr(P^2)=m uniquely determine the Haar projection second moment, and exact contractions give the stated coefficient. All dimensions and quantifiers are explicit; no finite computation is used as the proof.

value.rationale: The isotropic Gaussian is a canonical benchmark for a newly introduced two-parameter centro-sectional theory. The exact Hessian gives a full local stability phase diagram on the natural determinant-one Gaussian model, locates the structural threshold q=n independently of m, and supplies a reusable calibration for future variational and Minkowski analyses. This is more than a normalization check because it distinguishes strict local maximum and minimum regimes with an exact curvature modulus.
